EX-99.1 2 ck0002123613-ex99_1.htm EX-99.1 EX-99.1 Exhibit 99.1 PRESS RELEASE Kardigan Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Recent Business Updates Completed enrollment in Cohort 2 of Phase 2b danicamtiv KINSHIP-DCM trial, topline data expected in 2Q 2027; Phase 3 enrollment underway in both cohorts Completed enrollment in Phase 2b ataciguat KATALYST-AV trial; Week 48 topline data expected in 2H 2027 Cash position of $591.4 million supports multiple data readouts across all programs through 2027 and initiation of Phase 3 clinical trials SOUTH SAN FRANCISCO, Calif., and PRINCETON, N.J., Nov 12, 2026 — Kardigan™, Inc.

We expect to share topline data from the Phase 2b portion of the study in the second quarter of 2027, representing the first data readout from any placebo-controlled trial of people with dilated cardiomyopathy.

• Enrollment is complete in Cohort 2 (patients with non-MYH7/TTN variants or a family history of DCM) of the Phase 2b portion of the KINSHIP-DCM clinical trial, and topline data is expected in the second quarter of 2027; the Phase 3 trial is now enrolling across both cohorts.
• Topline data from the Phase 2b KATALYST-AV clinical trial of AVC at Week 48, alongside measures of cardiac structure and function, are expected in the second half of 2027.
Topline data are now expected in the second half of 2027.
